name: Shatter / death

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A forceful broad ice smashing crash followed by a dense cascade of sharp glassy chunks, dropping from high to low. One explosive frozen shatter, no sustained whistle.
